iDEP: Investigating Differentially Expressed Genes

If this site has contributed to your work, please cite our article:

Ge, S.X., Son, E.W. & Yao, R. iDEP: an integrated web application for differential expression and pathway analysis of RNA-Seq data. BMC Bioinformatics 19, 534 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2486-6

Summary

Read Counts data were analyzed using iDEP v2.4.4. The data was first filtered to remove reads below 0.5 CPM in at least 1 sample. Then the data was transformed with EdgeR using a pseudocount of 4. Missing values were imputed using geneMedian.

After mapping, there are 32833 unique genes in 158 samples. Of the 24127 genes passed filter, 24127 were converted to Ensembl/STRING gene IDs in our database. The remaining 0 genes were kept in the data using original IDs.

Differential expression analysis was performed using DESeq2 with an FDR cutoff of 0.1 and a minimum fold-change threshold of 2. Standard Wald test was used and independent filtering was enabled.

Selected Comparison: Time_After_Treatment_min1440-Time_After_Treatment_min0

Up-regulated genes: 431

Down-regulated genes: 317
